visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a grey Hello Kitty t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She gestures at the floor while looking directly at the camera with an expressive, slightly comedic face. (2) Close-up shots alternate between the woman's face and a light-colored tiled floor covered in pet hair, human hair, and food crumbs. A hand points to a specific hair on the floor. (3) The woman introduces the MOVA floor cleaner, a sleek black and silver device. She demonstrates its cleaning power by sucking up a large pile of noodles and a spill of soy sauce on the kitchen floor while a man watches in the background. (4) The camera shows detailed shots of the cleaner's roller brush, featuring a bright green LED light that illuminates hidden dirt. Overlays show a diagram of hot water being sprayed. (5) The woman interacts with two cats in a hallway, then uses the cleaner to pick up a thick clump of cat fur in a single pass. The camera focuses on the bottom of the device to show the brush is clean after use. (6) The woman demonstrates the 180-degree lay-flat feature by sliding the cleaner under a grey fabric sofa. The green LED light is clearly visible lighting up the floor under the furniture. (7) A sequence shows the maintenance cycle: the cleaner is placed in its docking station, the dirty water tank is removed and emptied into a sink, and the roller is shown being dried by hot air. (8) The video concludes with the woman standing next to the cleaner in a kitchen, smiling and giving a thumbs-up to recommend the product.
